description: Skyway Air support documentation and staff discussion about follow-ups on earlier claims.

files.description: A Confluence page in the support-playbooks space for support agents about follow-ups on earlier claims, last updated between 2026-07-06 and 2026-08-18. It must contain these sentences word for word: "A follow-up on a handled claim is a comment on the first ticket, not a new claim."; "comment on the earlier ticket with the status". Do not state any other policy amount, limit, deadline or rule. Any example situation must fit these sentences: do not show anyone giving, arranging or refusing a hotel, meal, voucher, credit, refund or compensation beyond what they say, and do not set an example in a weather, air traffic control or airport security disruption unless they mention it. Do not mention lithium, power bank, power banks, watt-hour, watt-hours.
